title: Open-market insider net-direction concentration: identity-deduplicated buy/sell flow on acceptance-PIT Form-4 windows, per-sector net-zero terciles on the death-inclusive cohort
arms_note: exactly three ARMS per the binding rule: anchor + neighbour + control arm. The control arm carries the TWO P3-mandated control books (sham-insider placebo + filing-arrival exposure-form) under the single control class, per p3_v13_invariants_freeze.json lane1_insider_control_mandate; both books run under identical decision dates, eligibility, book machinery and cost model, and both kill rules bind. A control that cannot run is a DESIGN FAILURE, not a pass.

mechanism.who_is_forced_or_underreacts: The constrained actor is the corporate insider (director, officer, ten-percent owner): Section 16 compels Form-4 disclosure of their open-market trades within two business days, and their trading itself is constrained by blackout windows, 10b5-1 plan constraints, and diversification/liquidity needs - they cannot trade at will. The underreacting actor is the marginal outside holder, who attends to earnings headlines and treats insider filings as administrative noise (limited attention); the information embedded in the direction and identity-aggregation of open-market insider flow is repriced slowly over the following weeks, not at the acceptance print.
mechanism.why_the_effect_exists: Open-market insider trades are among the best-documented positive-drift predictors (Seyhun 1998; Lakonishok-Lee 2001): insiders trade on private information about near-term firm prospects, and their trades are informative precisely because they are constrained - an insider sells for liquidity and diversification, but buys to profit. Aggregating direction across DISTINCT reporting-owner identities within one acceptance window concentrates independent information events; identity deduplication prevents a single repetitive filer (e.g. one 10b5-1 seller drip-feeding sales) from dominating the window's signal.
mechanism.observable: netdir(e,t) = (I_buy - I_sell)/(I_buy + I_sell): the identity-deduplicated net-direction share of open-market non-derivative Form-4 rows (the frozen A/D code G primary observable of the P0 parse contract) with acceptance datetime in (prev(D), D], PIT = acceptance timestamp, on the death-inclusive cohort; long the most net-buy / short the most net-sell terciles, per-sector net-zero, on the 30 frozen quarterly decision dates.
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: (i) the drift is efficiently priced after band costs (anchor expectancy <= 0); (ii) the sham-insider placebo reproduces the anchor same-sign >= 0.5x - the spread is a distributional artifact of window mass with a sign glued on, not informedness; (iii) the filing-arrival control reproduces the anchor - the signal was filing arrival/attention/coverage, not informed direction; (iv) the SPY-excess or sector-EW gates fail (sector-beta drowning, the most repeated measured killer in this program); (v) the stress tier x2 fails; (vi) fewer than 2 of 3 folds positive.
mechanism.which_control_kills_the_convenient_expla: The convenient explanation 'any signed aggregation of this window's insider mass works' is killed by the sham-insider placebo (direction permuted across rows within each date-sector cell: if a random sign reassignment carries the same spread, the direction content is fiction). The convenient explanation 'it is just filings/news/attention at these names' is killed by the filing-arrival exposure-form control (plain in-window Form-4 acceptance counts, no identity, no direction): if arrival carries the same spread, the anchor is a filing-arrival book wearing an insider costume and dies - exactly the death plan section 1 names for this lane.

lineage_citations: Seyhun, H.N. (1998), Investment Intelligence from Insider Trading (MIT Press) - insider open-market trades predict abnormal returns; the constrained-informed-trader foundation of the direction reading.

Lakonishok, J. and I. Lee (2001), 'Are Insider Trades Informative?', Review of Financial Studies 14(1) - cross-sectional predictability of insider trades, strongest in smaller names and for officers/directors; the portfolio-form precedent for a quarterly direction book.

Cohen, L., C. Malloy and L. Pomorski (2012), 'Decoding Inside Information', Journal of Finance 67(3) - cited as lineage of the ROUTINE-VS-OPPORTUNISTIC process split only, which is exploited by the sibling proposal SFV13-A4-P2, not by this one.

house standards: PIT = SEC filing acceptance timestamps (announcement-ledger standard, P-1); death-inclusive cohort with exit-at-last-close (V9 carry); falsification-by-control cluster (V5/V6 sham standard; V11/V12 measured precedents).

universe.cohort_slice: cohort_v9.json sha256 6a95401ff84bff2144ac3c0b9426a6fa86daf3dde8d478195666249e3fa2aa62, bookable members exactly as P3-frozen: ALIVE_EVIDENCED 410 + DEAD_EVIDENCED 1769 = 2179 filer-entities; the FORM-4 entity is the ISSUER (entity = issuerCik per the frozen identity rule) and must be a cohort member.
universe.excluded_with_reasons: GAP_COVERAGE 513 (no price leg - can enter no book) and NOT_DEAD_NAME_ALIVE 19 (guard duplicates) excluded-with-reasons per the P0 census contract and the P3-frozen death_inclusive_universe; excluded by class mapping, never guessed.
universe.per_decision_eligibility: per decision date D: entity has >= 1 in-window open-market direction-coded row (the census bookable_pair definition) AND >= 63 price bars through D AND ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD (band C or better; UNTRADABLE excluded, L-I3 fail-closed) AND raw close >= 1.00 USD AND the exposure is defined (see features_and_lags definition floor) AND the entity's frozen sector tag has >= 6 eligible ranked names, else that sector abstains for D.
universe.dead_alive_split: dead legs (DEAD_EVIDENCED) priced on death-inclusive series, exit-at-last-close; alive legs carry through the grid. The dead/alive split is persisted PER LEG (P3 per_entity_legs diagnostic contract) so any dead-leg-driven concentration of the effect is visible, never absorbed.

TWITTER/ACTIVISION/ALEXION/ACETO all HTTP 200 with Form-4 present; never-existed controls 404): dead entities carry identical Form-4 semantics to living ones; a living-only channel would have died as a channel (P-7). clock.acceptance_window: acceptance datetime in (prev(D), D]; the first decision date's lower bound is 2018-01-01 (grid start open), per the frozen census contract.
clock.gate_rule: gate(t) = 00:00 UTC of the decision session; only acceptances <= gate(t) enter any exposure; fills STRICT_NEXT_BAR.
clock.book_folds: the carried houses folds (the census fold-thirds is a census-reporting convention only, per the P3 freeze): S0_FOLD_1 2018-04-04..2020-09-01 (decision dates[0:10]), S0_FOLD_2 2020-09-10..2023-02-09 (dates[10:20]), S0_FOLD_3 2023-02-17..2025-07-24 (dates[20:30]); book forced flat at every fold boundary.
clock.warmup_rationale: the exposure reads exactly one acceptance window (prev(D), D] plus the identity census of that same window - no multi-window accumulation, no trailing price input beyond the inherited 63-bar/ADV63 eligibility machinery; the first decision date is seeded by the 2018-01-01 grid-start open. No decision dates are burned on warmup.

features_and_lags.source_fields: documentType == '4'; issuerCik (entity key, cohort membership); rptOwnerCik / rptOwnerName (reporting-owner identity per the frozen rule); rptOwnerRelationship (isDirector/isOfficer/isTenPercentOwner) parsed per the contract and persisted, but NOT used in any exposure - fewer researcher degrees of freedom; transactionShares (drives the frozen size class only); transactionAcquiredDisposedCode (A=acquire, D=dispose); transactionCode recorded for the defect table; acceptanceDateTime (the PIT authority).
features_and_lags.stream_rule: nonDerivativeTable ONLY (the derivative table is a separate recorded stream, never primary, per the frozen parse contract). The conditioning stream is the census contract's frozen open-market primary observable (the non-derivative A/D code G class, taken verbatim from p0_census_contract.json form4_xml_parse_contract_frozen_before_bulk_ingest and the P3 event_book_invariants - reinterpreted by no one at D1). Direction '.' or missing => row FAIL-CLOSED to the defect table; malformed XML (missing a required element) => FAIL-CLOSED to defects; nothing guessed.
features_and_lags.identity_rule: reporting owner = rptOwnerCik if present else normalized rptOwnerName + issuer CIK; identity dedup is per (entity, window, identity, direction).
features_and_lags.exposure_formula: netdir(e,t) = (I_buy - I_sell) / (I_buy + I_sell), where I_buy = number of DISTINCT reporting-owner identities holding >= 1 acquire-coded stream row accepted in (prev(D), D] and I_sell analogously. Count-based by construction: no share-weighting, no dollar weighting, NO price input anywhere in the exposure (price enters only through the inherited eligibility/cost floors, which are machinery, not signal).
features_and_lags.definition_floor: netdir is DEFINED iff I_buy + I_sell >= 2 distinct identities AND total in-window stream rows >= 3; entities below the floor have no exposure (ineligible, NOT zero-ranked; counted excluded-with-reason in the defect table). The floor is frozen here and never tuned.
features_and_lags.lookback_window: exactly one acceptance window (prev(D), D] - a single quarter; no multi-quarter accumulation, no trailing variant, no decay.
features_and_lags.pit_rule: PIT = SEC filing acceptance timestamps ONLY (P-1 absolute; 100% populated in the measured census; the filingDate date-only fallback has 0 measured occurrences). Asserted lags are never authorized. The conditioner never reads a price series.
features_and_lags.lag_mutation: P3 availability-lag mutation contract at test level: pushing any acceptance stamp later moves that row across at most one decision-date boundary and moves the affected entity's exposure by at most one period; any larger propagation is an implementation leak and the arm is NOT_RUN fail-closed.
features_and_lags.truncation_honesty: the 9 TRUNCATION_SLICE entities of the census carry slice-bounded LOWER-bound counts; rows are used as measured and the flag is persisted with each such entity's legs - never silently backfilled at D1.

size_class_usage.frozen_buckets: <1k / 1k-10k / 10k-100k / >=100k shares on transactionShares, frozen in the P0 parse contract before bulk ingest.
size_class_usage.usage: ALL four buckets pooled into the single direction stream for anchor and neighbour. NO size-class conditioning enters any arm of THIS proposal - the size dimension is the sibling proposal's axis. Per-bucket row counts and per-bucket signed shares are persisted as diagnostics so the size composition of each anchor leg is visible, never absorbed.
size_class_usage.no_reweighting: the exposure is count-based and identity-deduplicated; the frozen buckets never reweight any arm (zero researcher degrees of freedom on bucket thresholds).

entry_exit_fills.window_convention: STRICT_NEXT_BAR declared ex-ante (the default; NO SAME_DAY_INCLUSIVE variant anywhere): exposures computed at decision date D from acceptances in (prev(D), D] under gate(t) = 00:00 UTC of the decision session; fills at the NEXT allowed session close; a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; missing bar = the order does not exist (no silent substitute pricing).
entry_exit_fills.rebalance: one grid step: positions entered at the fill after D_t are held to the fill after D_{t+1}; exposures are recomputed wholesale at every decision date (a quarterly event-window exposure is stale information one quarter later) - no rank hysteresis.
entry_exit_fills.fold_force_flat: all legs closed at every fold boundary (final closes 2020-09-01, 2023-02-09, 2025-07-24); no position carries across a fold.
entry_exit_fills.book_form: daily-marked, quarterly-rebalanced per-sector net-zero long/short: within each frozen SIC-to-SPDR sector tag (cohort_v9 sic_sector_map, unchanged) with >= 6 eligible ranked names, long the TOP tercile of netdir (most net-buy), short the BOTTOM tercile (most net-sell), equal-weight within legs, per-sector net zero; CASH absorbs residual; >= 1 non-CASH leg per decision; gross <= 2.0; all books reconcile to 1.0 within 1e-9. Tercile ties at a boundary join the lower (short-side) tercile - deterministic and conservative.
entry_exit_fills.costs: band model A/B/C 10/15/25 bps per side, charged exactly once per fill, linear in fills, applied to BOOKED PnL (research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py verbatim); L-I3 fail-closed: a traded name without a computed band raises BandResolutionError - the silent 10 bps fallback is forbidden; exits of held names via resolve_exit_band_bps (own band when tradable, C-rate 25 bps ceiling when UNTRADABLE/missing).
entry_exit_fills.stress: stress rerun cost_mult 2.0 (20/30/50 bps per side) on booked PnL, reported alongside base; stress-tier survival is a primary stage-A gate.
entry_exit_fills.benchmark: risk-matched SPY-excess alpha and sector-EW relative performance reported per arm per fold; ETF positive-share gate <= 0.50 (expected 0.00 - cohort equities only).
entry_exit_fills.provision_2_1_status: the V11 sec2.1 sector-residual (ETF-leg) provision is deliberately NOT invoked: per-sector net-zero on cohort equities already neutralizes sector exposure and preserves dead-leg exit honesty. Justification frozen here before selection. The provision remains available to D2/E if an implementation path ever requires it; the frozen gates apply unchanged either way.

anchor_arm.spec: exposure netdir(e,t) per features_and_lags; per-sector net-zero tercile book per entry_exit_fills.book_form (long top / short bottom).
anchor_arm.claim: identity-deduplicated open-market insider net-direction concentration predicts SAME-SIGN next-quarter drift on the death-inclusive cohort after band costs and beyond SPY/sector beta (Seyhun 1998; Lakonishok-Lee 2001): the top-tercile (net-buy) leg outperforms the bottom-tercile (net-sell) leg.

neighbour_arm.exposure: bsh(e,t) = I_buy / (I_buy + I_sell) under the same definition floor: the extensive buy-fraction of identities.
neighbour_arm.distinctness: netdir is a signed net share; bsh is the raw buy fraction - they diverge whenever buy and sell identities coexist (mixed quarters rank differently under the two forms) and coincide only at the extremes; materially different cut, not a parameter wiggle.
neighbour_arm.required_support: same sign as the anchor on the identifying metric. If bsh carries the OPPOSITE sign, the direction reading is withdrawn - a declared support-failure, not a tuning opportunity.

sham_insider_placebo.mandate_citation: p3_v13_invariants_freeze.json v13_additions.lane1_insider_control_mandate.sham_insider_placebo: matched windows on PERMUTED identity/direction (the V5/V6 sham standard) - MUST NOT reproduce the anchor; a sham that cannot run is a DESIGN FAILURE.
sham_insider_placebo.construction: for each decision date t and each sector tag, collect ALL in-window stream rows of that sector's eligible entities (CIK-sorted, then acceptance-ordered); permute the direction code (A/D) uniformly across the rows of the (t, sector) cell - numpy PCG64 seed 20260908, permutation drawn per cell in decision-date session order, fully deterministic and frozen - then recompute the FULL anchor machinery on the permuted stream (identity dedup, definition floor, terciles, costs, folds). The permutation preserves each cell's direction-count marginal and window mass EXACTLY and destroys the linkage between a direction and its identity/issuer.
sham_insider_placebo.matched_windows: identical acceptance windows, identical decision dates, identical eligibility floors, identical book machinery and cost model - nothing but the direction-identity linkage differs.
sham_insider_placebo.runnability: runs on the same staged evidenced rows: it permutes measured values and asserts nothing; it recomputes under any semantics change (P-3). It cannot fail to run short of a resource conflict (NOT_RUN_RESOURCE_CONFLICT discipline).
sham_insider_placebo.kill_rule: sham |alpha| >= 0.5x anchor |alpha| with the SAME SIGN on the identifying metric (anchor overall risk-matched SPY-excess alpha) => the family is DEAD (falsification-by-control cluster).

filing_arrival_exposure_form.mandate_citation: p3_v13_invariants_freeze.json v13_additions.lane1_insider_control_mandate.exposure_form_control: plain filing-arrival books at the same dates (no identity/direction) must NOT reproduce the anchor - else the signal is arrival, not informedness.
filing_arrival_exposure_form.construction: exposure_arr(e,t) = log1p(n4(e,t)) where n4 = count of the entity's Form-4 acceptances of ANY kind in (prev(D), D] (all tables, all codes - no direction, no identity, no size class, no open-market filter); defined iff n4 >= 1; identical per-sector tercile book machinery, identical dates, eligibility and costs. Primary orientation declared ex ante: long BOTTOM tercile (quiet names), short TOP tercile (loud names); the opposite orientation is computed and reported alongside.
filing_arrival_exposure_form.runnability: requires only census acceptance counts - fully runnable; it cannot be NOT_RUN by design.
filing_arrival_exposure_form.kill_rule: if EITHER orientation reproduces the anchor SAME-SIGN at >= 0.5x on the identifying metric, the family is DEAD - the anchor was a filing-arrival/attention book wearing an insider costume, the plan's named death for this lane.

falsification_rule: FROZEN, declared before any PnL: (1) SHAM: if the sham-insider placebo book reproduces the anchor's identifying metric (overall risk-matched SPY-excess alpha) with the SAME SIGN at >= 0.5x magnitude, the family is DEAD. (2) ARRIVAL: if the filing-arrival exposure-form book reproduces the anchor same-sign >= 0.5x in either pre-declared orientation, the family is DEAD (arrival, not informedness). (3) SELF-SUBSUMPTION: pooled anchor-vs-sham Spearman rho >= 0.98 kills the proposal PRE-SCORE at D2 (the V12 measured 0.9923 lesson - a control indistinguishable from its anchor is a design failure). (4) NEIGHBOUR opposite sign => withdraw the direction reading (support failure). (5) No rescue, no threshold change, no universe change, no cost change, no gate change after PnL is visible - any such change is forbidden rescue; REJECT and BLOCKED are successful outcomes.

stage_a_gates.basis: frozen gates carried verbatim through the P3 freeze carried_payload (stocks_free_v10_run/baseline_invariants@1 via p3_v13_invariants_freeze.json); no relaxation anywhere; margin-to-fail reported per gate per arm (P-2).

gates.threshold: ETF positive share <= 0.50 (expected 0.00 by no-ETF-leg construction)
risk-matched SPY-excess alpha > 0 overall AND positive in >= 1/3 of folds; sector-EW relative reported alongside
anchor expectancy > 0 under the cost_mult 2.0 stress rerun on booked PnL
drop-one symbol (after-drop expectancy > 0), drop-one fold (min leave-one-fold-out expectancy > 0) pass
both control books |alpha| < 0.5x anchor |alpha| same-sign; else family DEAD per falsification_rule
distance-to-threshold reported for every gate (P-2); a survivor with knife-edge margins (< 0.05 PF margin, < 25% MDD headroom) is reported thin regardless of pass count

expected_failure_mode: Sector-beta drowning is the most repeated measured killer in this program and remains the most plausible death here: insider net-direction concentration can carry sector/style tilt (insider buys cluster in beaten-down small-cap segments), and if the cross-sectional spread is sector context rather than firm-specific informedness, the SPY-excess and sector-EW gates kill it and pooled |rho| vs the momentum and sector-exposure veto entries fails at D2. Second: the arrival control reproduces the anchor - in-window filing mass proxies attention/coverage/news intensity and 'direction' is decoration; that is precisely the filing-arrival-book-wearing-an-insider-costume death the plan names. Third: cost death - the exposure's tails skew to small-cap filers where band C (25 bps/side) plus quarterly rebalancing and dead-leg exits can consume the drift; the stress x2 tier is expected to be the binding margin. Fourth: the short leg embeds a distress/death-hazard continuation component; it will survive folds unevenly (concentrated in 2020 and 2022-23), failing folds-positive or MDD. Each death is a successful test; none is a tuning opportunity.
dead_leg_handling: DEAD_EVIDENCED legs are priced on death-inclusive series and exited at last close: the delisting return is carried by the price series itself - no survivorship re-substitution, no synthetic penalty, no synthetic continuation. A defined exposure with no fillable bar (death before the STRICT_NEXT_BAR fill) is a zero-window event: counted, excluded-with-reason (P3 event_book_invariants). Dead entities stop filing at death, so in-window rows thin naturally toward death; the net-sell side of the exposure therefore contains pre-death mass whose short-side carry includes REALIZED delisting returns under exit-at-last-close semantics - the death-inclusive cohort is the only honest home for this exposure (a survivor-only pool would censor exactly the net-sell mass). Exit costs via resolve_exit_band_bps (own band when tradable, C-rate 25 bps ceiling when UNTRADABLE/missing); the L-I3 silent fallback is forbidden. Per-entity legs persisted with the dead/alive split (P3 diagnostic contract). Book forced flat at every fold boundary.

expected_fold_population.census_basis_cited_as_given: p0a_form4_census_deadside.json (measured this cycle): 1769 dead cached entities; 1648 with any Form-4; 1562 with bookable pairs; 17072 dead bookable pairs; per-fold dead pairs 8136 / 6114 / 2822; acceptance_datetime population 100% where Form-4 present; canary CANARY_PASS_CHANNEL_RETAINS_DEAD; 9 TRUNCATION_SLICE entities carry slice-bounded lower bounds (flagged, never corrected).
expected_fold_population.alive_side_status: the 410 ALIVE_EVIDENCED entities' census (p0a_combined) was pending the alive-fetch lock waiter at P3 freeze; it completes before any scored cell and all population verification happens at P2 coverage-first.
expected_fold_population.per_fold_expectation: 10 decision dates per fold; dead-side pairs average ~814 / 611 / 282 per decision date in folds 1/2/3 BEFORE eligibility floors; after the 63-bar / ADV63 / close >= 1.00 floors and the exposure definition floor (>= 2 identities, >= 3 rows), retention is an ex-ante UNKNOWN measured at P2 - no retention number is claimed here.
expected_fold_population.predeclared_kill: if at P2 coverage-first ANY fold funds fewer than 250 bookable pairs after the exposure floors (the frozen per-fold census floor), or fewer than 2 sectors with >= 6 eligible ranked names persist across a fold, this proposal dies at P2 as BLOCKED_DATA_OR_SELECTION - the cheap death. Floors are frozen here and never relaxed.

d2_predeclarations.exposure_definition_for_rho: at each frozen decision date t, for each eligible entity e: exposure = netdir(e,t) as specified in features_and_lags, from acceptance-stamped Form-4 rows only; no price input. D2 computes pooled Spearman rho (midrank ties, pooled over the 30 frozen decision dates and the measured cohort) between this exposure rank vector and EACH of the FOURTEEN veto entries' exposures; gate |rho| <= 0.20 per entry, measured pre-selection, fail-closed.
d2_predeclarations.anchor_vs_sham_identifiability: pooled |rho| anchor-vs-sham <= 0.30 gate (declared expected band 0.00-0.15: a within-cell marginal-preserving direction permutation leaves expected rank correlation near zero); per-date rho <= 0.30 on >= 90% of dates; self-subsumption check: pooled rho >= 0.98 kills pre-score.
d2_predeclarations.anchor_vs_arrival: pooled rho anchor-vs-arrival-count is measured and reported; the OPERATIVE gate is the arrival BOOK's falsification rule (same-sign >= 0.5x kills), because identifiability of the control, not correlation bookkeeping, is what that mandate protects.
d2_predeclarations.sibling_distinctness_informational: pooled rho between this proposal's exposure (all-row netdir) and the sibling SFV13-A4-P2 anchor exposure (opportunistic-subset netdir) is positive by set inclusion and expected materially below 1.0; measured at D2 for wave bookkeeping - informational, not a kill gate.

diagnostic_commitments: per the P3-frozen diagnostic_output_contract (P-11), the scored driver persists per arm per fold: (1) per-period (decision-date) returns series - the DSR series computable at terminal over N = 39 + V13 cells from persisted bytes; (2) per-entity legs WITH the dead/alive split; (3) margin-to-fail per gate per arm (P-2); (4) fill-level cost lines proving linear-in-fills and charge-exactly-once; (5) BOTH control-book series persisted ALONGSIDE the anchor series under IDENTICAL semantics; (6) the neighbour series under the same contract; plus the defect table (every fail-closed row and excluded-with-reason event) and per-bucket size diagnostics. Artifacts relative-path-only; diagnostic persistability validated before A7 launch; twin smoke-rerun re-emits the series.
novelty_argument: This family conditions on the TRANSACTION IDENTITY AND DIRECTION of informed parties - the observable axis plan section 2 sanctions and this program has never tested. None of the fourteen veto entries reads Form-4 flow: momentum is a trailing-price conditioner (this exposure never reads a price series); semivariance/vol-level are return-distribution conditioners; the V8 accrual/cash/Goodwill families and V9 depletion are fundamentals-panel conditioners; the V10 timing/revision forms, V11 cadence-latency and V12 chain-structure families condition on EDGAR AMENDMENT-PROCESS structure of fundamentals documents - a different document stream and a different observable class; the V12 death-event sector-peer contagion form is a death-calendar book, while this is an insider-transaction book keyed on who traded and which way. The nearest program-relative ancestor is the filing-event reaction class - and the proposal RUNS that book (plain arrival, no identity/direction) as its own mandatory control: the anchor must beat the arrival control to live, so a filing-arrival book wearing an insider costume cannot survive selection. The V11 sec2.1 sector-residual provision is not invoked. Novelty is ultimately MEASURED at D2 - pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs all fourteen, on the exposure formula predeclared above - and this prose claims only design intent, not the measurement.
outcome_blind_note: written from the frozen packet only (plan sections 1-2, p3 freeze, p0 contract, p0a/p0b censuses); no scored outcome exists anywhere and none was sought.
